records.preparation: Dilute the liquid concentrate with water according to the film and desired compensation. Tetenal documents working dilutions from approximately 1+10 to 1+30.
records.reuseInstructions: Tetenal describes Ultrafin Liquid for one-shot film development; prepare the selected working dilution for the current batch and discard after use.
records.capacityText: 250 ml concentrate processes up to about 20 films; a 1 litre package up to about 80 films, depending on working dilution and tank volume.
records.sourceTitle: Tetenal B/W Chemistry Catalogue - Ultrafin Liquid

records.preparation: Dilute one concentrate portion with water to the film-specific working solution; the product is designed for highly dilute fine-grain one-shot processing.
records.reuseInstructions: Use the prepared working solution once and discard after the processing batch.
records.capacityText: A 500 ml working solution is intended for approximately one to two films, depending on film area and process conditions.
records.sourceTitle: Tetenal B/W Chemistry Catalogue - Neofin Blue

records.preparation: Dilute concentrate with water in the manufacturer range approximately 1+15 to 1+31, depending on the process and film.
records.reuseInstructions: Tetenal documents Neopress HC for replenished processing as well as conventional working solutions; maintain activity by replenishment when used as a production bath.
records.capacityText: Tetenal documents capacities up to approximately 160 films per litre of concentrate in replenished/production use, depending on process conditions.
records.sourceTitle: Tetenal B/W Chemistry Catalogue - Neopress HC

records.preparation: Dilute concentrate with water; Tetenal documents working dilutions 1+25 and 1+50.
records.reuseInstructions: Prepare the high-dilution working solution for the current batch and discard it after use.
records.capacityText: A 250 ml concentrate package processes up to about 25 films, depending on working dilution and tank volume.
records.sourceTitle: Tetenal B/W Chemistry Catalogue - Paranol S

records.manufacturer: Hans O. Mahn GmbH & Co. KG / MACO PHOTO PRODUCTS
records.preparation: Dilute the concentrate with water. The Rollei data sheet documents 1+9, 1+12 and 1+15 and gives exact concentrate/water quantities for 260 ml working solution.
records.capacityText: The 500 ml concentrate package is intended for roughly 20 to 60 film developments depending on the selected dilution and working volume.

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Dilute the concentrate with water according to the film-specific SPUR development chart. Working dilution and agitation are selected together to control speed and contrast.
records.capacityText: SPUR specifies a minimum of 6 ml concentrate for one 35 mm film; smaller quantities have not been validated by the manufacturer.

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Dilute the concentrate with water according to the film and target exposure index in the SPUR chart; working dilution is varied together with development time and agitation to obtain the required speed/contrast result.

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Prepare the working solution with distilled water at the film-specific dilution in the SPUR chart. Hard water requires longer development times; the manufacturer used distilled water for its calibrated values.

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Dilute the concentrate according to the film development chart; for paper the standard manufacturer dilution is 1+20.
records.capacityText: For film, 250 ml concentrate develops about 30 35 mm or roll films on average. For paper at 1+20, one litre working solution develops about 40 RC enlargements 18x24 cm.
records.storageNotes: SPUR describes UFP as a long-shelf-life universal developer but does not provide a numeric keeping time in the cited product information.
records.sourceTitle: SPUR UFP Universal Developer manufacturer information

records.manufacturer: SPUR Photochemie Dr. Heidrich und Schain GbR
records.preparation: Prepare the working solution from concentrate according to the film-specific SPUR NHC development chart. The product is intended for pictorial high-contrast black-and-white development.
records.sourceTitle: SPUR NHC Data Sheet and current SPUR price list
